subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should OpenClaw accept this picker-only accessibility affordance now, or hold it for the broader linear workspace design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82450?
rationale: The patch appears narrow and correct for the chat picker slice, but it changes user-visible accessibility wording/position semantics and the PR has a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide product acceptance.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Approve the picker-only slice once conflicts are resolved, keeping the broader linear workspace request open for later design.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Design
options.body: Pause or close this branch and handle picker numbering as part of a complete linear workspace/accessibility design.

options.title: Request UX Wording Adjustments
options.body: Ask for specific ordinal or screen-reader wording changes before re-review if the current loaded-list phrasing is not the desired product language.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the picker-only slice once conflicts are resolved, keeping the broader linear workspace request open for later design.
